'''Uhr-Vah-Vo TechWorks''' was a [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]]-operated company that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A couple of decades prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company produced the [[Model 88-series administration droid]], which was intended for use as a clerical and administration droid. The droid attracted the attention of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and the Clan purchased the majority of the production run, and later bought out Uhr-Vah-Vo.
